references.text: Describes the basic procedure for bird offerings, including pinching off the head at the neck, which is the same technique mentioned in Lev 3:5–8
The preceding verse that explains the context for this offering—two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one as a sin offering and one as a burnt offering
Continuation of the ritual describing what should be done with the blood from the sin offering
Another case where two turtledoves or two young pigeons are used as offerings, one as a sin offering and one as a burnt offering
Similar offering regulation with two turtledoves or two young pigeons for purification after childbirth
The priest shall offer them, one as a sin offering and one as a burnt offering—the same pattern as in Lev 3:5–8
The Nazirite shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, one as a sin offering and one as a burnt offering
